QuestInfo.name: Pulling Strings
QuestInfo.0: You defeated the #bPuppeteer#k! Now #bNeinheart#k wants to talk to you. What could it be about?
QuestInfo.1: #bNeinheart#k seems to have something to give you for reaching Level 20. Listen to what he has to say.
QuestInfo.2: You have reached Level 20, and #bNeinheart#k explained to you about the Black Wings. And now he is about to tell you about #bEdelstein#k, the territory of the Black Wings...
QuestInfo.rewardSummary:

Can proceed to Edelstein and the Resistance

1.0:
And... you're back. 
Before I explain what you're to do next, I have a question: How did it feel to fight the #bPuppeteer#k?
#L0##bIt was a cinch. Why? Is this a trick question?#l
#k
1.1: Only partially. #bFrancis the Puppeteer#k is the lowest ranked #bBlack Wing#k commander, so I'm relieved you were able to defeat him with ease. \r\n#L0##bBut I shouldn't get too cocky because the other commanders will be tougher, right?#l\n#k
1.2: Precisely. Black Wing commanders have strange abilities, such as that #bShapeshifter#k you encountered during your training.\r\n#L0##bWhy are they trying to resurrect the Black Mage, anyway?#l\n#k
1.3:
They are fools who believe the #bBlack Mage#k will create a world in which they'll possess ultimate power. It is a shame to see such capable beings waste their talent on false promises. #rI will not rest until each and every one of them are eliminated.#k 
#L0##b(Note to self, never get on Neinheart's bad side.) I get it. We have to stop them.
#l
#k
1.4: Yes, #b#h0##k, but our enemies are strong. If they weren't, they would not have already managed to conquer an entire continent.

yes.0: #bEdelstein#k, the land of machines and minerals, is under their command. \r\nSpeak to me again when you are ready for the details.
